title: Foundations: Lyrical Rap - The Complete Guide
summary: What Lyrical Rap is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Lyrical Rap songs: Boom-bap is 1990s East Coast hip-hop in its purest form: hard drums (boom-bap), dusty jazz and soul samples, and intricate lyricism. DJ Premier and Pete Rock are its architects.

History: Named for the kick-snare pattern, boom-bap defined New York hip-hop 1992–1997: Nas's Illmatic, Wu-Tang's Enter the 36 Chambers, Gang Starr, and A Tribe Called Quest.

How the songs work: Lyrical Rap favors the keys of Sample-based. Common forms include DJ scratches on the hook; One MC, one DJ, no chorus needed. Players should master chopping: slicing samples into new melodies first, then the premier scratch chorus. Chopped samples need no capo.

title: Lyrical Rap Etude No. 1: Soul chop vi–IV–I
summary: An original Lyrical Rap study in Sample-based drilling the premier scratch chorus.
body:
This original etude isolates the 'Soul chop vi–IV–I' progression in the key of Sample-based — the changes Lyrical Rap players must know cold.

CHART:
Cm | G# | D# | G7

FORM: one mc, one dj, no chorus needed.

PRACTICE: loop the chart slowly, adding the premier scratch chorus once the changes are clean. Then transpose with the included program and drill it in all twelve keys — the Lyrical Rap player's rite of passage.

title: N.Y. State of Mind - Lyrical Rap Song Study
summary: Harmonic blueprint and playing guide for N.Y. State of Mind by Nas (1994).
body:
N.Y. State of Mind — Nas, 1994. Premier's piano loop; Nas's coronation.

HARMONIC BLUEPRINT (study chart, key of Sample-based):
Cm7 | F7 | Cm7 | F7

This study chart uses the 'Jazz loop ii–V' progression, the Lyrical Rap workhorse, to map how songs like this move. Form: dj scratches on the hook. Listen for hard kicks, snappy snares, swung hats — it is the fingerprint of the style.

TO PLAY IT: set your tempo to the Lyrical Rap pocket, voice the chords cleanly, and let hard kicks, snappy snares, swung hats. Chopped samples need no capo. (Song facts: title/artist/year are documented public records; the chart is an original study arrangement.)
